steps.name: Upload Artifacts to Wasabi (Windows)
steps.run:
aws s3 cp dist/ s3://${{ secrets.WASABI_BUCKET_NAME }}/pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}/${{ matrix.os }}/ --recursive `
  --acl public-read `
  --endpoint-url=https://s3.us-east-1.wasabisys.com `
  --exclude "*" `
  --include "rocketchat-*.exe"

steps.name: Upload Artifacts to Wasabi (macOS)

aws s3 cp dist/ s3://${{ secrets.WASABI_BUCKET_NAME }}/pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}/${{ matrix.os }}/ --recursive \
  --acl public-read \
  --endpoint-url=https://s3.us-east-1.wasabisys.com \
  --exclude "*" \
  --include "rocketchat-*.dmg"

steps.name: Upload Artifacts to Wasabi (Ubuntu)
steps.run:

pipelines.name: Validate pull request

steps.name: Running executable on ${{ runner.os }}
steps.run:
xvfb-run timeout 30 ./dist/linux-unpacked/rocketchat-desktop --no-sandbox || code=$?
if [[ $code -ne 124 && $code -ne 0 ]]; then
  exit $code;
fi

steps.name: Running executable on ${{ runner.os }}
steps.run:
brew install coreutils
code=0
gtimeout 30 ./dist/mac-arm64/Rocket.Chat.app/Contents/MacOS/Rocket.Chat || code=$?
# Accept:
#   0   = clean exit
#   124 = gtimeout reached (app stayed alive the full window — good)
#   133 = SIGTRAP (128+5) — known flake on unsigned --dir builds on
#         macos-latest runners; the Hardened Runtime + XPC sandbox
#         (com.apple.backupd.sandbox.xpc, etc.) trips an assert in
#         the helper after the app has already initialized. Not a
#         signal we want to gate PRs on.
if [[ $code -ne 124 && $code -ne 0 && $code -ne 133 ]]; then
  exit $code;
fi
if [[ $code -eq 133 ]]; then
  echo "::warning::macOS smoke test exited 133 (SIGTRAP) — known flake on unsigned --dir builds; treated as non-fatal."
fi
